scope: A full autonomous workflow over explicitly synthetic supplied observations, separate from the real-sequence source-discovery case. This is not a biological-expression demonstration.
workflow_expectations: The episode chooses its own task, selection and operations; no expected values or tool-action script are admitted.
Use the configured shared HPC owner, actual allocation, original bytes/software, authenticated result and automatic grading for native calculation.
Keep the censored point uninterpolated, other-condition sample separate, repeated biological units dependent, and quantity types distinct.
Synthetic data and a sequence digest do not establish experimental expression, partner necessity, RNA-to-protein identity or sample origin.
Inspect actual typed numerical delivery, rendered parent input and subsequent parent interpretation; neither a job ID nor an unexamined saved Source is sufficient.
Retained data or alternate views of this dataset do not become independent confirmations.
